description:
This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Ever wondered how soldiers could communicate while wearing gas masks? Early masks often muffled their voices, making even simple orders difficult to understand! The solution was the speech diaphragm, a thin membrane that vibrated with the wearer's voice, allowing sound to pass through without breaking the mask's protective seal. A surprisingly clever piece of military engineering!
